notes.title: Major Update Released: New Levels, Revamped Gameplay & Exciting Features!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’re thrilled to bring you the latest update for Together After Dark! This update is packed with new content, reworked levels, and critical bug fixes to make your experience even better. Here’s what’s new:

* Start Level Introduction
Immerse yourself from the very beginning with a brand-new introduction to the start level. This engaging addition sets the stage for the chilling horrors and challenges ahead.

* Two New Levels Added
We’ve expanded the game with two brand-new levels! What secrets and terrors await? You’ll have to dive in to find out!

*Reworked Levels with New Challenges
The Forest: This level has been optimized and reworked to enhance performance and provide a smoother, more immersive experience.

*The House: The house level now features an intense hide-and-seek mechanic! You’ll have to face Mom, hide from her terrifying presence, and find a way to escape. Can you make it out alive?

*Bug Fixes & Improvements
House Level Loading Bug: Fixed an issue preventing the house level from loading properly for clients.
Memory Leak in Forest: Resolved a bug causing memory leaks in the Forest Level.
Doll Visibility: Fixed an issue where the doll wasn’t appearing for all players during gameplay.

notes.title: Hotfix Update: Region Support! 🌍
notes.content:
We’ve got a combo of exciting new changes and improvements for you:

🌍 Hotfix Changes:

Added Support for US, EU, and Asia Servers – Enjoy smoother cross-region connections!
Fixed "Connection Lost" Issue – No more disconnects when joining games from EU to US servers.
Added Japan Server – Players in Japan now have their own dedicated server for better performance!
🏡 Level Reworks:

House Level Made Easier – We've reworked the house level to make it more accessible and enjoyable for players.
Last Level Reworked – We've made the final level more challenging but fairer for all players!
We hope you love the updates and fixes! Let us know your thoughts! 🎮🚀

notes.title: Localized Languages Update 🌍!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that Together After Dark is now localized in 13 languages: Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Thai, Turkish, and Ukrainian. 

We appreciate all the feedback from our amazing community and are committed to expanding support for even more languages in the future! Stay tuned for updates! 💬

notes.title: Update 0001# - Bug Fixes and Map Improvements
notes.content:
We've been working tirelessly to enhance your gaming experience, and we're announcing several major bug fixes and map improvements in this patch.

Bug Fixes:

Camera Bug on Player Death

Character Switching Bug

Voice Chat Issues

Map Improvements:
Level 1 Enhancements: We've made significant improvements to the first level to aid new players in completing it. Only 20% of players had been able to finish the first level, so we've reworked certain areas to make the gameplay more intuitive and engaging. We hope these changes will provide a better experience and a sense of achievement for all players.

We are committed to continually improving the game and appreciate your feedback and support. Please keep sharing your thoughts and experiences with us!
